hunks.baseline: The only ones they had to worry about were the Embroidered Uniform Guard.
hunks.sol: The only ones they worried about were the Embroidered Uniform Guard.

hunks.baseline: The Guard, little more than the Emperor’s watchdogs, wore golden armor the same yellow as a mongrel’s coat. Their specialty was combing every corner as if hunting for lice.
hunks.sol: Little more than the Emperor’s watchdogs, the Guard wore golden armor as yellow as a mongrel’s coat. Their specialty was combing every corner as if hunting for lice.

hunks.baseline: They sniffed out their target, tracked it down, sank their foul-smelling teeth into its neck, then ran back to their master, wagging their tails.
hunks.sol: They sniffed out a target, tracked it down, sank their foul-smelling teeth into its neck, then ran back to their master, wagging their tails.

hunks.baseline: And with so many eyes and ears throughout the imperial capital, even the most secretive movements were bound to nag at them like a fish bone caught in the throat.
hunks.sol: With so many eyes and ears throughout the Imperial Capital, though, even moving in the strictest secrecy left them uneasy, like a fish bone caught in the throat.

hunks.baseline: Until the last person they were waiting for appeared with a faint noise.
hunks.sol: Then, with a faint noise, the last person they were waiting for appeared.

hunks.baseline: The old hatch overhead opened, and a dim shaft of light spilled in. Their eyes, accustomed to the darkness, narrowed reflexively, but they didn’t let down their guard.
hunks.sol: The old hatch overhead opened, and dim light spilled in. Their eyes, accustomed to the darkness, narrowed reflexively, but they didn’t let down their guard.

hunks.baseline: The newcomer immediately understood what their eyes were asking.
hunks.sol: The newcomer immediately understood what their looks meant.

hunks.baseline: A low groan rose from them all at once. The dozen or so guests watched the changes around the man with grave expressions.
hunks.sol: A low murmur rose from them all at once. The dozen or so guests watched the changes overtaking the man with grave expressions.

hunks.baseline: His features twisted like a wave.
hunks.sol: His features rippled like a wave.

hunks.baseline: With the sound of hundreds of bones shifting out of place, his body alternately shrank and stretched.
hunks.sol: With the sound of hundreds of bones shifting out of place, his body shrank and stretched, again and again.

hunks.baseline: The transformation happened in an instant. In the time it took for a blink, not a trace of the man they’d just seen remained.
hunks.sol: The transformation happened in an instant. A moment later, not a trace of the man they’d just seen remained.

hunks.baseline: In his place stood a handsome man in his thirties or forties, with a lean build.
hunks.sol: In his place stood a handsome, lean man in his thirties or forties.

hunks.baseline: At last, the guests recognized the face before them and let go of the tension that had kept them taut.
hunks.sol: At last, the guests recognized the face before them and relaxed.

hunks.baseline: After modestly brushing off his astonishing disguise technique and Bone-Shrinking Technique, Ma Sanbao continued.
hunks.sol: Having modestly brushed off his astonishing disguise technique and Bone-Shrinking Technique, Ma Sanbao continued.

hunks.baseline: “It wasn’t as bad as I expected. Your loyal subordinates helped us, and we disguised ourselves much more thoroughly this time.”
hunks.sol: “It wasn’t as bad as I expected. Your loyal subordinates helped us, and we took far greater care with our disguises.”

hunks.baseline: Their only goal was to overthrow the man sitting on the throne now—the Emperor who had brutally slaughtered countless friends with whom they had shared their affection for so long, and comrades with whom they had stood side by side in pursuit of their ideals, before turning that fearsome blade on them.
hunks.sol: Their only goal was to overthrow the man sitting on the throne now—the Emperor who had brutally slaughtered countless longtime friends and comrades who shared their cause, then turned that fearsome blade on them.

hunks.baseline: “Couldn’t agree more. We can refill the vessel as it empties, and replace the cracked, bloodstained one with a new one.”
hunks.sol: “Couldn’t agree more. We can refill the vessel as it empties, and replace the cracked one that reeks of blood with a new one.”

hunks.baseline: They had ridden the tiger and were now clinging to its back. Only two choices remained: let fear drive them to climb down and be eaten alive, or hold on with all their might until the exhausted tiger could take no more—and plunge a dagger into the back of its neck.
hunks.sol: They had ridden the tiger and were now clinging to its back. Only two choices remained: let fear drive them to climb down and be eaten alive, or hold on with all their might until the tiger exhausted itself—and plunge a dagger into the back of its neck.

hunks.baseline: Thus, their fervent hopes and wishes came together, and at last a document bearing all their signatures was born.
hunks.sol: Thus, their fervent hopes and wishes came together, and at last they drew up a pledge bearing all their signatures.

hunks.baseline: They would wait for the day when the time came to defy heaven.
hunks.sol: They would wait for the time to defy heaven.

hunks.baseline: More than a decade had passed since the day the imperial capital ran red with blood.
hunks.sol: More than a decade had passed since the day the Imperial Capital ran red with blood.

hunks.baseline: White frost had settled on the heads of the old ministers who had barely survived, but the faction they’d secretly built with painstaking effort had grown even stronger and larger. The child who had left for the frontier, bundled in swaddling clothes, had returned as a boy. And an ominous air was slowly gathering over the imperial capital.
hunks.sol: White frost had settled on the heads of the old ministers who had barely survived, but the faction they’d secretly built with painstaking effort had grown stronger and larger. The child who had left for the frontier bundled in swaddling clothes had returned as a boy. And an ominous air was slowly gathering over the Imperial Capital.

hunks.baseline: At the old-sounding voice of someone wearing a precise human-skin mask that made him look middle-aged, the others let out low groans.
hunks.sol: At the aged voice of a man whose finely made human-skin mask made him look middle-aged, the others let out low groans.

hunks.baseline: Was it because they hadn’t expected it at all?
hunks.sol: Was it because the thought had never occurred to them?

hunks.baseline: No. It was because his words had sharply pointed to the truth they were all trying to ignore.
hunks.sol: No. His words had laid bare the truth they were all trying to ignore.

hunks.baseline: They too had stumbled and rolled around in the filth of politics, and lived to tell the tale.
hunks.sol: They too had stumbled and rolled through the filth of politics and lived to tell the tale.

hunks.baseline: Every head turned toward him at once. Ma Sanbao, who had been listening quietly to the conversation, broke his long silence and spoke.
hunks.sol: Every head turned toward him at once. Ma Sanbao, who had been listening quietly to the conversation, broke his long silence.

hunks.baseline: “It’s just as I’d expect from the man who nurtured so many pillars of the Hanlin Academy. Your mind is as sharp as ever, even past eighty.”
hunks.sol: “It’s just as I’d expect from the man who nurtured the pillars of the Hanlin Academy. Your mind is as sharp as ever, even past eighty.”

hunks.baseline: “I agree with His Excellency the Grand Secretary.”
hunks.sol: “I agree with His Excellency the Grand Academician.”

hunks.baseline: The others fell silent for a moment. Ma Sanbao had invoked his title as Brush-Holding Eunuch for a reason.
hunks.sol: The others fell silent for a moment. Ma Sanbao had invoked his title for a reason.

hunks.baseline: “But it’s already clear whose blood will be mixed into that wind. The storm is almost upon us, and both sides will have to throw everything they have into the clash.”
hunks.sol: “But it’s already clear whose blood will be caught up in that storm. It’s almost upon us, and both sides will have to throw everything they have into the clash.”

hunks.baseline: “Brush-Holding Eunuch Ma. Forgive me for asking, but can we really stand against the Emperor? From what we’ve learned so far, their forces are far beyond what we expected…”
hunks.sol: “Brush-Holding Eunuch Ma. Forgive me for asking, but can we really stand against the Emperor? From what we’ve learned so far, their forces are far greater than we expected…”

hunks.baseline: The one who’d cautiously spoken regretted it at once.
hunks.sol: The man regretted speaking almost at once.

hunks.baseline: Ma Sanbao’s eyes had shot toward him, cold and keen as a blade, making his heart sink.
hunks.sol: Ma Sanbao’s gaze had shot toward him, cold and keen as a blade, making his heart sink.

hunks.baseline: He forced out his apology in a voice that would barely come. Ma Sanbao withdrew his gaze as if nothing had happened and replied calmly.
hunks.sol: He forced out the apology in a voice that would barely come. Ma Sanbao withdrew his gaze as if nothing had happened and replied calmly.

hunks.baseline: “We’ve trusted one another and boarded the same boat. We have to row together if we’re going to get anywhere. Isn’t that right?”
hunks.sol: “We’ve trusted one another and boarded the same boat. We all have to row together if we’re going to get anywhere. Isn’t that right?”

hunks.baseline: “Don’t worry. We have more than enough justification and strength to bring the Emperor down.”
hunks.sol: “Don’t worry. We have the justification and the strength to bring the Emperor down.”

hunks.baseline: “I can’t tell you everything, but we’ve made sufficient preparations for this great undertaking. Please understand that I can’t say more than that.”
hunks.sol: “I can’t tell you everything, but we’ve made ample preparations for this great undertaking. Please understand that I can’t say more than that.”

hunks.baseline: When Ma Sanbao put it that way, the others quietly folded away the questions lingering on their tongues and tucked them into a corner of their hearts.
hunks.sol: When Ma Sanbao put it that way, the others tucked their unasked questions away.

hunks.baseline: Besides, though each of them had contributed some measure of influence and power, Ma Sanbao was one of the key figures at the very heart of this plan.
hunks.sol: Besides, though each of them had contributed some measure of influence and power, Ma Sanbao was one of the key figures in this plan.

hunks.baseline: Much like a certain old minister, once a Grand Secretary of the Hanlin Academy—the cradle of the realm’s talent—who still held sway over the court even after retiring from office.
hunks.sol: Much like a certain old minister: the Grand Academician of the Hanlin Academy, the cradle of the realm’s talent, who still held sway over the court even after retiring from office.

hunks.baseline: Ma Sanbao immediately understood the meaning behind the sudden question and answered.
hunks.sol: Ma Sanbao immediately understood the sudden question and answered.

hunks.baseline: “But he won’t get what he wants. I’ll say this with confidence: for now, even the Emperor won’t find it easy to reach that person with his evil designs.”
hunks.sol: “But he won’t get what he wants. I’ll say this with confidence: for now, even the Emperor won’t find it easy to lay a hand on that person.”

hunks.baseline: “The whole imperial capital is boiling like a pot left over a fire. Before long, it’ll spill over in every direction.”
hunks.sol: “The whole Imperial Capital is boiling like a pot left over a fire. Before long, it’ll spill over in every direction.”

hunks.baseline: “It’ll be a Hongmen Banquet.[^1] Their spears and swords will decide who lives and dies.”
hunks.sol: “It’ll be a Hongmen Banquet.[^1] Blades will cross, and lives will hang in the balance.”

hunks.baseline: “It won’t be the same as Hongmen. Xiang Yu was foolish enough to let Liu Bang live, but the Emperor won’t make that mistake.”
hunks.sol: “It won’t be the same as Hongmen. Xiang Yu was foolish enough to let Liu Bang live, but the Emperor won’t do that.”

hunks.baseline: The old minister quietly nodded, lost in thought. Then he suddenly spoke.
hunks.sol: The old minister quietly nodded, lost in thought. Then he spoke.

hunks.baseline: “But if he has his master, that changes things.”
hunks.sol: “But if his master is there, that changes things.”
